about: The six markets of 01-SHARED-INTERFACE.md section 4, one list per network, each entry in the shape of the MarketInfo type. Indexes differ per network and can change: they are pinned at deploy and re-checked before each deploy.
source: Hyperliquid POST /info {"type":"metaAndAssetCtxs"}, pulled 2026-11-11, recorded in research-scripts/hl_markets_2026-11-11.txt. Every index and size-decimals value below was compared with that file on 2026-11-11.

notes.SHIB: Hyperliquid name kSHIB: one unit is 1,000 SHIB
notes.PEPE: Hyperliquid name kPEPE: one unit is 1,000 PEPE

number_format: A price has at most 5 significant figures and at most 6 - sz_decimals decimal places; a size has sz_decimals decimal places; trailing zeros are removed. Prices and sizes are sent as whole numbers scaled by 100,000,000 (_e8).
